title: MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding for the costs associated with the Los Angeles Korean Festival.
text:
[Council File 26-1409; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding for the costs associated with the Los Angeles Korean Festival.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $61,151 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281210 (CD 10 Redevelopment Project - Services) to the Recreation and Parks Fund No. 302/88, Revenue Source No. 4145 and Central Revenue Source No. 4512 (Work Order: RAPX6017) for costs associated with the Los Angeles Korean Festival.
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $7,871.74 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281210 (CD 10 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Recreation and Parks Fund No. 301/88, Revenue Source No. 4155 and Central Revenue Source No. 4515 (Work Order: MRPXX111 & MRPXX965) for costs associated with the Los Angeles Korean Festival.
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $1,164.26 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281210 (CD 10 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Recreation and Parks Fund No. 302/89, Revenue Source No. 4155 and Central Revenue Source 4515 (Work Order: SP89XW03) for costs associated with the Los Angeles Korean Festival.
AUTHORIZE the Department of Recreation and Parks to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Council motion to fund costs of the Los Angeles Korean Festival with about $70,000 in CD 10 redevelopment project funds, moved to Recreation and Parks accounts in three transfers.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 13, 2026)
